code: BUG: the Lyapunov readout perturbed along a FIXED x each step and averaged the one-step stretch - stretching along x, not along the unstable direction. For the dissipative Lorenz flow that average is negative: the chaotic attractor read 'lambda ~ -0.048 (stable)'. Now Benettin's method (separation carried forward and renormalised; per unit time for the flow). Probe, 60k steps: Lorenz -0.048 -> +1.02 (literature 0.906; explicit Euler at dt 0.005), Clifford 0.41 -> 0.29

BUG: the bump goes on the left of travel and the triangle ran counter-clockwise: inward - the anti-snowflake. The triangle now runs clockwise, so a single left-to-right segment (the longhand rule) still bumps upward
